Selecting Addresses for Business Partners
Selecting Addresses for Business Partners
Prerequisites
You have defined multiple addresses for a business partner want to use each of these addresses for a specific purpose (for example, for dunning notices).
Procedure
In the
Create Contract Account
/
Change Contract Account
(
CAA1
/
CAA2
) transactions, on the
General Data
,
Payments
/
Taxes
, or
Dunning
/
Correspondence
tab pages, call the input help for the
Address Description
field.
A selection window appears with the business partner addresses maintained in the master record.
Choose the required address, for example, that you want to send a dunning notice to, by double-clicking it.
Result
The selected address is transferred. In the contract account master record, the
Fixed
indicator next to the address field is now selected. It indicates that a specific address was selected and not the standard address of the business partner.
Note
You can use this function to select the address for each business partner in the contract account, regardless of whether this is the owner of the contract account to be created or changed, or an alternative business partner (such as the dunning recipient).
If you do not select an address, the default address of the contract account holder is used automatically for all business transactions.
